verdict.rationale: Relay offers rule-based automations that run without manual intervention — auto-transfers on deposit, percentage/dollar-based multi-account splits, multi-step approval rules, and recurring invoices (relay-docs-1, relay-docs-6, relay-docs-15, relay-docs-17, relay-docs-18) — which qualifies as background automation. However this is traditional banking rule automation, not AI/agent-driven decisioning, and community evidence notes manual execution is still required for many external payments (relay-comm-1). Missing for 10: any AI/LLM-based autonomous decision-making, agent-triggered actions, or evidence of automations beyond simple scheduled/rule-based transfers.
